"""D-36 Stage 3.5A completeness cross-check for 069500 (structure/dates only, no return/perf values).

Cross-references:
  1) Merged price CSVs (2002-10-14 ~ 2016-08-31) for internal date contiguity.
  2) Distribution Excel (분배금) dates against the merged price series, to confirm
     every distribution event has a corresponding trading-day price record.

Never prints price/NAV magnitudes or any derived return/performance figure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

DOWNLOADS = Path("/mnt/c/Users/gram/Downloads")
PRICE_FILES = [
    "data_4421_20260909.csv",  # 2002-10-14 ~ 2003-09-30 (gap-fill)
    "data_2117_20260909.csv",  # 2003-10-01 ~ 2005-09-30
    "data_2207_20260909.csv",  # 2005-10-04 ~ 2007-09-28
    "data_2256_20260909.csv",  # 2007-10-01 ~ 2009-09-30
    "data_2339_20260909.csv",  # 2009-10-01 ~ 2011-09-30
    "data_2416_20260909.csv",  # 2011-10-04 ~ 2013-09-30
    "data_2444_20260909.csv",  # 2013-10-01 ~ 2015-09-30
    "data_2515_20260909.csv",  # 2015-10-01 ~ 2016-08-31
]
DIST_XLS = DOWNLOADS / "상품별_분배_현황_20260908.xls"


def load_price_dates() -> pd.Series:
    frames = []
    for name in PRICE_FILES:
        path = DOWNLOADS / name
        df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="cp949", usecols=["일자"])
        df["일자"] = pd.to_datetime(df["일자"], format="%Y/%m/%d")
        df["__source"] = name
        frames.append(df)
    merged = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    return merged


def main() -> None:
    price = load_price_dates()
    dates = price["일자"]

    print("=== 1) 가격 CSV 병합 구조 점검 ===")
    print("총 행수:", len(price))
    print("고유 날짜 수:", dates.nunique())
    dup = price[dates.duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values("일자")
    print("중복 날짜 행수:", len(dup))
    if len(dup):
        print("중복 날짜 목록 (파일간 겹침 확인용):")
        print(dup.groupby("일자")["__source"].apply(list).to_string())

    print("날짜 범위:", dates.min().date(), "~", dates.max().date())

    sorted_dates = dates.sort_values().reset_index(drop=True)
    gaps = sorted_dates.diff().dt.days
    big_gaps = sorted_dates[gaps > 5]
    print(f"5일 초과 연속 공백(달력일 기준) 지점 수: {len(big_gaps)}")
    if len(big_gaps):
        for idx in big_gaps.index:
            prev_date = sorted_dates.iloc[idx - 1].date()
            cur_date = sorted_dates.iloc[idx].date()
            print(f"  gap: {prev_date} -> {cur_date} ({(sorted_dates.iloc[idx]-sorted_dates.iloc[idx-1]).days}일)")

    date_set = set(sorted_dates.dt.date)

    print()
    print("=== 2) 분배금 지급기준일 vs 가격 데이터 존재 여부 교차검증 ===")
    dist_raw = pd.read_excel(DIST_XLS, engine="xlrd", header=2)
    print("분배 파일 컬럼:", list(dist_raw.columns))

    code_col = next((c for c in dist_raw.columns if "코드" in str(c)), None)
    date_col = next((c for c in dist_raw.columns if "지급기준일" in str(c)), None)
    print("사용 컬럼 -> 코드:", code_col, " / 기준일:", date_col)

    dist = dist_raw.copy()
    if code_col is not None:
        normalized = dist[code_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(6)
        dist_069500 = dist[normalized == "069500"]
    else:
        dist_069500 = dist

    dist_069500 = dist_069500.copy()
    dist_069500[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(dist_069500[date_col].astype(str), format="%Y%m%d", errors="coerce")
    dist_069500 = dist_069500.dropna(subset=[date_col])

    print("069500 분배 이벤트 수:", len(dist_069500))
    print("분배 지급기준일 범위:", dist_069500[date_col].min().date(), "~", dist_069500[date_col].max().date())

    in_window = dist_069500[
        (dist_069500[date_col] >= sorted_dates.min()) & (dist_069500[date_col] <= sorted_dates.max())
    ]
    print("가격 데이터 구간(2002-10-14~2016-08-31) 내 분배 이벤트 수:", len(in_window))

    matched = in_window[date_col].dt.date.isin(date_set)
    print("정확히 일치하는 거래일에 가격 기록 존재:", matched.sum(), "/", len(in_window))
    unmatched = in_window[~matched]
    if len(unmatched):
        print("불일치(비거래일 지급기준일 - 정상일 수 있음, 인접 거래일 확인 필요) 목록:")
        for d in sorted(unmatched[date_col].dt.date.tolist()):
            nearest_after = [x for x in sorted(date_set) if x >= d]
            nearest_before = [x for x in sorted(date_set) if x <= d]
            na = nearest_after[0] if nearest_after else None
            nb = nearest_before[-1] if nearest_before else None
            print(f"  {d}: 직전 거래일={nb}, 직후 거래일={na}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
